name: po-o11
prompt:
In server/src/overview.rs, replace the body `todo!("unit o11")` of fn access_part with the real code. Keep its signature and doc comment exactly. Spec: returns json!({ "grants", "mcp", "knowledge", "assets", "commands" }); map every sqlx error to Err(e.to_string()) with `?`.
- grants: [] when p.repo_machine_id or p.repo_folder is None. Else `SELECT target, rights, expires FROM machine_grants WHERE machine_id = ? ORDER BY target` as Vec<(String, String, Option<String>)>, keep only rows where covers(&target, folder), each {"target", "rights": serde_json::from_str::<Vec<String>>(&rights).unwrap_or_default(), "expires": expires (null when None)}.
- mcp: `SELECT server, tool, expires FROM mcp_grants WHERE user_id = ? AND expires > ? ORDER BY server, tool` bound user_id and util::now(), each {"server", "tool", "expires"}.
- knowledge: `SELECT c.id, c.name FROM knowledge_project kp JOIN knowledge_collection c ON c.id = kp.collection_id WHERE kp.project_id = ? ORDER BY c.name`, each {"id", "name"}.
- assets: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_asset WHERE project_id = ?` as i64.
- commands: [] when p.repo_machine_id is None. Else let dev = devsettings::Settings::parse(&p.dev_settings); for kind in ["build", "test", "run", "deploy"] where dev.command(kind) is Some(cmd): {"kind": kind, "command": cmd, "last": dev.last.get(kind) (serialize it with json!; null when missing), "fromHere": kind != "deploy"}.
Change nothing else in the file; the other functions keep their todo!() until their own job.
